text:
Maya (People Ops): Quick help please — Diego submitted a taxi expense from Madrid but he says he paid cash for tip and driver scribbled a paper receipt thats faint. He attached a photo but its barely legible. Policy says cash receipts ok if under €50, but total was €62 incl tip. Thoughts?
Diego: Yep, I paid driver €50 fare + €12 tip in cash. Driver gave me that tiny receipt (attached). Card showed only the fare later on my bank SMS for €50. I dont have an app trip receipt, this was a local taxi.
Hannah: For cash portions we require a converging evidence pattern: (1) merchant receipt (even handwritten), (2) card/statement showing the non-cash portion, and (3) a short attestation by the employee describing the cash amount/tip.
Maya (People Ops): Can we approve with that? The combined evidence shows total equals claimed amount. Finance?
Finance Review: We can approve if the handwritten receipt + bank SMS match dates and the attestation specifies the cash tip amount. Also require manager sign-off for cash+card > €50.
Diego: Ok I can add an attestation line: "Taxi on 2026-03-20 from Barajas to hotel. Fare €50 on card; tip €12 cash paid to driver. Receipt image attached. - Diego". Is that fine?
Expense Bot: Reminder: redact any PAN digits from screenshots. Upload file types .jpg/.png. Filenames should include date, e.g., 2026-03-20-madrid-taxi.jpg. If manager approval is required, include manager email in the expense comment.
Hannah: Also note for future: if tipping in cash abroad, note both currencies if you claim in USD/GBP — include the original currency and the USD equivalent using the banks conversion rate shown on the statement.
Maya (People Ops): Great — Diego, please add the attestation text, attach the bank SMS screenshot (redacted), and ask your manager to post a one-line approval in the expense thread (manager name/email ok). Finance will then clear it.
Diego: Will do, thanks.
Maya (People Ops): I'll update the receipts wiki with a short checklist for foreign cash tips + handwritten receipts so approvers have a consistent rubric. :memo:
